1.web: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira, his wife, sold a possession,
1.asv: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,

2.web: and kept back part of the price, his wife also being aware of it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
2.asv: and kept back part of the price, his wife also being privy to it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles’ feet.

3.web: But Peter said, “Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit, and to keep back part of the price of the land?
3.asv: But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thy heart to lie to the Holy Spirit, and to keep back part of the price of the land?

4.web: While you kept it, didn’t it remain your own? After it was sold, wasn’t it in your power? How is it that you have conceived this thing in your heart? You haven’t lied to men, but to God.”
4.asv: While it remained, did it not remain thine own? and after it was sold, was it not in thy power? How is it that thou hast conceived this thing in thy heart? thou hast not lied unto men, but unto God.

5.web: Ananias, hearing these words, fell down and died. Great fear came on all who heard these things.
5.asv: And Ananias hearing these words fell down and gave up the ghost: and great fear came upon all that heard it.

6.web: The young men arose and wrapped him up, and they carried him out and buried him.
6.asv: And the young men arose and wrapped him round, and they carried him out and buried him.

7.web: About three hours later, his wife, not knowing what had happened, came in.
7.asv: And it was about the space of three hours after, when his wife, not knowing what was done, came in.

8.web: Peter answered her, “Tell me whether you sold the land for so much.” She said, “Yes, for so much.”
8.asv: And Peter answered unto her, Tell me whether ye sold the land for so much. And she said, Yea, for so much.

9.web: But Peter asked her, “How is it that you have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? Behold, the feet of those who have buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out.”
9.asv: But Peter said unto her, How is it that ye have agreed together to try the Spirit of the Lord? behold, the feet of them that have buried thy husband are at the door, and they shall carry thee out.

10.web: She fell down immediately at his feet, and died. The young men came in and found her dead, and they carried her out and buried her by her husband.
10.asv: And she fell down immediately at his feet, and gave up the ghost: and the young men came in and found her dead, and they carried her out and buried her by her husband.

11.web: Great fear came on the whole assembly, and on all who heard these things.
11.asv: And great fear came upon the whole church, and upon all that heard these things.

12.web: By the hands of the apostles many signs and wonders were done among the people. They were all with one accord in Solomon’s porch.
12.asv: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people: and they were all with one accord in Solomon’s porch.

13.web: None of the rest dared to join them, however the people honored them.
13.asv: But of the rest durst no man join himself to them: howbeit the people magnified them;

14.web: More believers were added to the Lord, multitudes of both men and women.
14.asv: and believers were the more added to the Lord, multitudes both of men and women:

15.web: They even carried out the sick into the streets, and laid them on cots and mattresses, so that as Peter came by, at the least his shadow might overshadow some of them.
15.asv: insomuch that they even carried out the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that, as Peter came by, at the least his shadow might overshadow some one of them.

16.web: Multitudes also came together from the cities around Jerusalem, bringing sick people, and those who were tormented by unclean spirits: and they were all healed.
16.asv: And there also came together the multitude from the cities round about Jerusalem, bringing sick folk, and them that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed every one.

17.web: But the high priest rose up, and all those who were with him (which is the sect of the Sadducees), and they were filled with jealousy,
17.asv: But the high priest rose up, and all they that were with him (which is the sect of the Sadducees), and they were filled with jealousy,

18.web: and laid hands on the apostles, and put them in public custody.
18.asv: and laid hands on the apostles, and put them in public ward.

19.web: But an angel of the Lord opened the prison doors by night, and brought them out, and said,
19.asv: But an angel of the Lord by night opened the prison doors, and brought them out, and said,

20.web: “Go stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.”
20.asv: Go ye, and stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this Life.

21.web: When they heard this, they entered into the temple about daybreak, and taught. But the high priest came, and those who were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.
21.asv: And when they heard this, they entered into the temple about daybreak, and taught. But the high priest came, and they that were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison-house to have them brought.

22.web: But the officers who came didn’t find them in the prison. They returned and reported,
22.asv: But the officers that came found them not in the prison; and they returned, and told,

23.web: “We found the prison shut and locked, and the guards standing before the doors, but when we opened them, we found no one inside!”
23.asv: saying, The prison-house we found shut in all safety, and the keepers standing at the doors: but when we had opened, we found no man within.

24.web: Now when the high priest, the captain of the temple, and the chief priests heard these words, they were very perplexed about them and what might become of this.
24.asv: Now when the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these words, they were much perplexed concerning them whereunto this would grow.

25.web: One came and told them, “Behold, the men whom you put in prison are in the temple, standing and teaching the people.”
25.asv: And there came one and told them, Behold, the men whom ye put in the prison are in the temple standing and teaching the people.

26.web: Then the captain went with the officers, and brought them without violence, for they were afraid that the people might stone them.
26.asv: Then went the captain with the officers, and brought them, but without violence; for they feared the people, lest they should be stoned.

27.web: When they had brought them, they set them before the council. The high priest questioned them,
27.asv: And when they had brought them, they set them before the council. And the high priest asked them,

28.web: saying, “Didn’t we strictly command you not to teach in this name? Behold, you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching, and intend to bring this man’s blood on us.”
28.asv: saying, We strictly charged you not to teach in this name: and behold, ye have filled Jerusalem with your teaching, and intend to bring this man’s blood upon us.

29.web: But Peter and the apostles answered, “We must obey God rather than men.
29.asv: But Peter and the apostles answered and said, We must obey God rather than men.

30.web: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you killed, hanging him on a tree.
30.asv: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom ye slew, hanging him on a tree.

31.web: God exalted him with his right hand to be a Prince and a Savior, to give repentance to Israel, and remission of sins.
31.asv: Him did God exalt with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, to give repentance to Israel, and remission of sins.

32.web: We are His witnesses of these things; and so also is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him.”
32.asv: And we are witnesses of these things; and so is the Holy Spirit, whom God hath given to them that obey him.

33.web: But they, when they heard this, were cut to the heart, and determined to kill them.
33.asv: But they, when they heard this, were cut to the heart, and were minded to slay them.

34.web: But one stood up in the council, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, honored by all the people, and commanded to put the apostles out for a little while.
34.asv: But there stood up one in the council, a Pharisee, named Gamaliel, a doctor of the law, had in honor of all the people, and commanded to put the men forth a little while.

35.web: He said to them, “You men of Israel, be careful concerning these men, what you are about to do.
35.asv: And he said unto them, Ye men of Israel, take heed to yourselves as touching these men, what ye are about to do.

36.web: For before these days Theudas rose up, making himself out to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were dispersed, and came to nothing.
36.asv: For before these days rose up Theudas, giving himself out to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were dispersed, and came to nought.

37.web: After this man, Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the enrollment, and drew away some people after him. He also perished, and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered abroad.
37.asv: After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the enrolment, and drew away some of the people after him: he also perished; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered abroad.

38.web: Now I tell you, withdraw from these men, and leave them alone. For if this counsel or this work is of men, it will be overthrown.
38.asv: And now I say unto you, Refrain from these men, and let them alone: for if this counsel or this work be of men, it will be overthrown:

39.web: But if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow it, and you would be found even to be fighting against God!”
39.asv: but if it is of God, ye will not be able to overthrow them; lest haply ye be found even to be fighting against God.

40.web: They agreed with him. Summoning the apostles, they beat them and commanded them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
40.asv: And to him they agreed: and when they had called the apostles unto them, they beat them and charged them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.

41.web: They therefore departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for Jesus’ name.
41.asv: They therefore departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for the Name.

42.web: Every day, in the temple and at home, they never stopped teaching and preaching Jesus, the Christ.
42.asv: And every day, in the temple and at home, they ceased not to teach and to preach Jesus as the Christ.
